chapters.title: I have loved you
chapters.summary: God tells Israel He has loved them, but the priests offer blind and sick animals and despise His name. His name will be great among the nations.

chapters.title: A covenant broken
chapters.summary: The priests have failed to teach truly. The people deal treacherously with one another and with the wives of their youth, for God hates divorce.

chapters.title: The refiner's fire
chapters.summary: God will send His messenger to prepare the way, and He will come like a refiner's fire. Bring the full tithe and see if He will not open heaven's windows. A book of remembrance is written.

chapters.title: The sun of righteousness
chapters.summary: For those who fear His name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings. God will send Elijah to turn the hearts of fathers and children.
